hints: Exclusive-or cancels pairs, and here the values come in threes. Think about one bit position at a time instead.
Across the whole row, each bit position is set a multiple of three times, plus one more if the lonely value has that bit.
So counting how often each of the thirty-two bit positions is set, and taking the remainder on division by three, rebuilds the lonely value.
The compact version replaces the thirty-two counters with two integers - 'seen once' and 'seen twice' - which together count to three in every bit position at the same time.
